resources.string: Share your cycle, send doodles and leave little surprises for each other!
Encrypted file from afar or Bluetooth nearby.
Nothing syncs automatically. Each exchange is started by you.

By file:
1. Create “My invitation” and save or share the .ritela file with your partner.
2. Your partner opens it and saves their own invitation. Compare the codes — they must match.
3. Both confirm the code and send the updated invitations back.
4. Receive your partner’s confirmation — “Connection confirmed” appears.

By Bluetooth:
1. Pair the phones in Android Bluetooth settings.
2. Open “My invitation” on both phones. On one choose “Receive via Bluetooth”; on the other choose “Bluetooth” and the phone.
3. Compare and confirm the codes on both phones.
4. Exchange invitations via Bluetooth again to finish connecting. Your calendar and doodles are sent separately.
Confirm the same code on both phones and exchange the updated invitations by file or Bluetooth. Data exchange stays unavailable until both sides confirm.
You can now exchange data and little messages. Your next exchanges will check the trusted keys automatically.
For a new connection with a short verification code, update Ritela on the other phone. Existing trusted contacts keep working.
Draw a doodle, leave a message or plan a little surprise.
Shared information will appear here after you receive an exchange.
